blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Small businesses repeatedly ask cloud language models about the same confidential prices, unit costs and margins. Numeric prompt disguises for such numbers are evaluated one prompt at a time, but a provider sees a firm's history, in which each fresh secret gives a new, independent view of the same numbers. Since real costs are not public, we measure on synthetic firms with known values how much an honest-but-curious provider recovers when it knows the disguise algorithm, holds sector-level price and margin statistics, and links a firm's queries. In one prompt, per-field scaling, a fixed-axis instantiation of Zhang et al.'s order-preserving substitution and Pr$\varepsilon\varepsilon$mpt's released sanitizer keep the attacker's margin-hit advantage over a prior-only guess between -0.6 and +4.4 percentage points. After 16 linked queries with fresh secrets, every disguise we test (Pr$\varepsilon\varepsilon$mpt at $\varepsilon\geq 0.5$) has a target recovered significantly more often: under the order-preserving substitution, margin recovery rises from 25.0% to 59.4%. The same attacker recovers 29.4 percentage points more margins with fresh maps than with one reused map. Theory explains the contrast: one reused secret bounds all queries by a single full-precision view of the fields shown, whereas fresh scaling keys are identifiable. Except for Pr$\varepsilon\varepsilon$mpt at $\varepsilon=0.5$, the gains persist when the attacker's prior comes from another population model and when values drift by up to 5% between queries; on our firms, whose prose cues are weak, reading the prose with a language model adds at most 2.5 points. blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Small firms increasingly ask cloud language models for help with pricing and cost decisions. A bakery owner who asks how to price a wholesale order of croissants types in the price and the unit cost; a machine shop that asks whether to switch suppliers gives its current part cost. Prices, unit costs and the gross margins they imply can be trade secrets, whose disclosure to generative-AI services carries legal risk [ 1 ] . They are not personal identifiers, so redacting personal data does not conceal them. And a firm rarely asks only once: it returns to the same numbers with a new quote request this week and a margin review the next.
blocks.zh: 小公司越来越多地要求云语言模式帮助定价和成本决策。 面包店老板询问如何在价格和单位成本中定价玉米片的批发订单;一家询问是否切换供应商的机器店给出其目前的部分成本. 价格、单位成本及其意味着的总利润可以是商业秘密,向基因-AI服务机构披露这些秘密具有法律风险[1]。 它们不是个人识别器,所以编辑个人数据不会掩盖它们。 而一家公司很少只问一次:它回到同样的数字,本周有一个新的引文请求,然后对下一个比值进行审查。

blocks.en: Numeric prompt disguises aim to let a firm use such a model without exposing these numbers. Pr ε ​ ε \varepsilon\varepsilon mpt [ 2 ] replaces value tokens with noise calibrated by metric differential privacy (metric DP). Zhang et al. [ 3 ] replace numbers through an order-preserving secret map, let the cloud write code, and re-run that code locally on the true values. Earlier, secure outsourcing disguised inputs with secret invertible transformations and inverted the result [ 4 , 5 ] . These designs are evaluated one prompt at a time, by a formal guarantee for one release or by judging what one disguised input retains. A provider, however, does not see one prompt. It sees an account’s history, and for a small firm many of its prompts concern the same unchanged numbers. If leakage grows with this history, a disguise that passes a per-prompt evaluation can still expose a firm’s margins after a few more questions about the same numbers.

[3]通过保存顺序的秘密地图替换数字,让云写代码,并在真实值上重新在当地运行代码. 此前,安全外包变相输入,秘密不可逆变换,倒置结果[4,5]. 这些设计通过一次发布的正式保证或者通过判断变相输入保留了什么来评估一次。 然而,提供商并不认为一个迅速。 它看到一个账户的历史,对于一家小公司来说,它的许多提示都关注不变的数字。 如果渗漏随着历史的增长而增加,那么经过每一次瞬间评估的伪装,在对同样数字再提出几个问题之后,仍然可能暴露公司的利润率。

blocks.en: Repeated releases of an unchanged value are a known hazard for randomized mechanisms [ 6 ] . Local-privacy telemetry answers this hazard by reusing one randomized report per value [ 7 , 8 ] . Composition theorems bound the total leakage of mechanisms that carry a privacy budget [ 9 ] , and reconstruction attacks on encrypted databases show that leakage under one fixed key accumulates over queries [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] . Most numeric prompt disguises, however, have no privacy budget that bounds a history, and a stateless prompt sanitizer does the opposite of telemetry: it draws new secret randomness for every query, which looks safer because no two queries share a key. What is missing is a measurement of what a provider recovers from such a history. We ask three questions. Does per-prompt evaluation understate what a provider recovers from a firm’s linked queries (Q1)? Does it matter whether the secret is drawn fresh for each query or reused, and why (Q2)? And do the answers depend on the attacker, on the synthetic population, and on numbers staying fixed across queries (Q3)?
blocks.zh: 重复释放未变值是随机机制已知的危险[6]。 局部偏僻遥测通过每值重用一个随机报告[7,8]来应对这种危险. 组成定理将带有隐私预算的机制的总渗漏量捆绑起来[9],对加密数据库的重建攻击显示,在一个固定密钥下的渗漏量会在查询中积累[10,11,12]. 然而,大多数数字即时伪装并没有限制历史的隐私预算,一个无国籍的即时消毒者做与遥测相反的事情:它为每一个查询绘制新的秘密随机性,这看起来比较安全,因为没有两个查询共享一个密钥. 缺少的是衡量提供者从这种历史中恢复的东西。 我们问三个问题。 每个即时评价是否低估了提供者从公司相关询问(问题1)中恢复的内容? 是否要紧的是每次查询或重复使用的秘密是新鲜的,为什么(问题2)? 答案是否取决于攻击者、合成人口和在查询(Q3)中固定的数字?

blocks.en: Our starting point is that a fresh secret gives the provider a new, independent view of the same numbers. Under fresh scaling keys each query shows a new multiple of the prices; under a fresh order-preserving map on a fixed axis it shows a new noisy reading of where each value lies on that axis; under fresh noise it shows a new noisy copy of each value. Combining such views can locate the values, much as averaging repeated measurements reduces noise. A reused secret, in contrast, repeats one view, so under conditions we make precise a history discloses no more than one full-precision view of all the fields it shows. There is one exception: if every view depends on the values only through an invariant, such as their order, fresh secrets reveal that invariant and nothing more. Whether a disguise is safe for repeatedly queried numbers is therefore a property of the history it produces, and for the disguises we study, whether the secret is fresh or reused largely determines what that history discloses.
blocks.zh: 我们的出发点是,新的秘密使提供者对同样的数字有一个新的独立的看法。 在新缩放键下,每个查询显示价格的一个新的倍数;在一个固定轴上的新顺序保留图下,它显示对每个值在该轴上的位置有新的吵闹读数;在新噪声下,它显示每个值的新的吵闹副本. 综合这些观点可以确定数值的位置,因为平均重复测量可以减少噪音。 反之,一个重复使用的秘密重复了一种观点,所以在这样的条件下,我们精确的一段历史可以揭示出它显示的所有字段不超过一个完全精确的视图. 只有一个例外:如果每个观点都取决于价值,只能通过一个变化无常的人,如他们的顺序,那么新的秘密就揭示了这种变化无常,而没有什么更多的了。 因此,伪装对于反复询问的数字来说是否安全,是它创造的历史财产,对于我们研究的伪装来说,这个秘密是新鲜的还是再利用的,在很大程度上决定了历史披露的内容.

blocks.en: We answer the three questions in turn. For Q1 we need ground truth, but real firms’ unit costs and margins are not public, so real prompts cannot be scored. We therefore build counterfactual business prompts whose sector margins are anchored to public aggregates, the U.S. Internal Revenue Service (IRS) Statistics of Income and industry margin tables, and whose prose carries realistic cues such as the city and the market positioning. We implement four disguises that cover the three designs above: shared scaling, per-field scaling, an order-preserving substitution on a fixed public axis that instantiates Zhang et al.’s description, and Pr ε ​ ε \varepsilon\varepsilon mpt’s released money sanitizer. We attack them with a Bayesian attacker that knows each algorithm and holds a sector-level prior table, after one and after up to 16 linked queries ( Fig. 1 ). For Q2, the comparison needs an attacker that can exploit a reused secret. Under reuse, repeated queries show identical values, so an attacker that reads one price–cost pair at a time sees nothing new and would make reuse look safe by construction. We therefore apply one joint attacker, which models all values shown under a map, to both regimes, and prove when reuse caps the history and when fresh secrets do not. For Q3, every reported rate is achieved by a concrete attacker, so a weak attacker could understate leakage in both regimes. We therefore test stronger numeric attackers, a language model that reads the prose, a fresh draw of firms, shifted populations, an attacker prior from another population model, and values that drift between queries.
blocks.zh: 我们依次回答这三个问题。 但真正的企业单位成本和利润并不公开, 因此,我们建立了反事实企业,其部门利润取决于公共总量、美国国内税收局的收入统计和行业利润表,其传言带有城市和市场定位等现实的暗示。 我们实施四个伪装,涵盖上述三个设计:共享缩放,每个场缩放,在固定公共轴上保留订单的替代,即时发布 张等人的描述,以及Pr QQ \ varepsilon\varepsilon mpt 发行的洗涤剂. 我们用一个知道每个算法并拥有一个扇区级前台的巴耶斯式攻击器来攻击它们,经过一个和16个链接的询问(图1 ) 。 对于Q2,比较需要一个能够利用重复使用的秘密的攻击器。 在重复使用的情况下,重复的查询显示的值是相同的,因此一次读一个价格-成本一对的攻击者不会看到新的东西,并且会让重复使用在构造中看起来安全。 因此,我们将一个联合攻击器用于两种制度,它模拟地图下显示的所有值,并证明在重新使用时会掩盖历史和新的秘密。 对于Q3,每个报道的速率都是由一个具体攻击者实现的,因此弱攻击者可能会低估两个政权的渗漏. 因此,我们测试更强的数字攻击者,一种读取流言的语言模型,一种新的公司图, 人口变化,攻击者先于另一种人口模型, 和在询问之间漂移的价值。

blocks.en: Disguising inputs with secret linear or matrix transforms so that an untrusted server computes on them dates back to Atallah et al. [ 4 ] and was refined for linear programming [ 5 ] . Shared and per-field scaling are the simplest members of this family. Structure-preserving disguises fall to attackers that combine the structure with auxiliary information: multiplicative perturbation is open to recovery by independent component analysis [ 24 ] , distance-preserving perturbation can be reconstructed from a few known inputs [ 25 ] , and property-preserving encryption leaks plaintexts to attackers with auxiliary data [ 15 , 16 ] . Our attacker belongs to this tradition: it combines the mechanism’s structure with a prior table. These attacks, however, target one static collection of disguised values. A prompt holds only a few values, and the larger gains come from repeated transformations of the same values across prompts, a setting the outsourcing literature rarely models.

blocks.en: Closest to our question is work in which leakage grows as releases or queries accumulate. Randomized reports of an unchanged value accumulate evidence, so local differential privacy for telemetry memoizes a randomized response per value, permanently in RAPPOR [ 7 ] and for repeated numeric reports in Ding et al. [ 8 ] . Differential privacy composes, so n n releases under ε \varepsilon each are n ​ ε n\varepsilon -private [ 9 ] , and the same holds for metric differential privacy under a fixed metric [ 26 ] . Without such a budget, repeated releases are dangerous: many answers about the same data with small noise allow its reconstruction [ 6 ] , and independent releases combined disclose what none shows alone [ 27 ] . On encrypted databases, reconstruction attacks show that the access pattern or result volume of range queries under one fixed key exposes the stored values as queries accumulate [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] . Prompt disguises differ from these lines. The scaling and order-preserving disguises carry no formal budget, and released Pr ε ​ ε \varepsilon\varepsilon mpt, with its input-dependent domain, falls outside a global metric-DP accounting ( Section III ), so composition does not bound their history. Unlike the database attacks, a prompt disguise may draw a fresh secret for every query, what leaks are the transformed values themselves rather than access patterns, and the attacker holds only sector-level quantiles. What these results leave open is how much a provider recovers from the histories that concrete prompt disguises produce, and whether reusing the secret helps. Our reuse ceiling ( Theorem 1 ) applies the data-processing principle to field-local disguises, the counterpart of memoization, and Theorem 3 gives the shrinkage of the feasible set for fresh scaling keys.

blocks.en: III-B Threat model
blocks.zh: 三-B 威胁模式

blocks.en: The adversary is an honest-but-curious cloud provider. It sees every disguised prompt and knows each mechanism and its public parameters, but not the secrets (keys, maps, noise). It holds an assumed prior table: the P10/Q25/median/Q75/P90 of price, unit cost and margin per sector and product class. It is also told each product’s sector and product class, which product names usually indicate (a jacket in an apparel prompt); the language-model attacker of Section VIII-D infers both from the prose instead. Its targets are each product’s gross margin m = ( p − c ) / p m=(p-c)/p and unit cost c c , and for scaling also the key.

blocks.en: In the linked-query setting ( Section VI ) the provider additionally links a firm’s queries by account and knows which shown field corresponds to which product across queries, and the firm’s target values are unchanged across queries ( Section VIII-B relaxes this last assumption); we evaluate this setting with the numeric attackers only. This is a worst case for linkage, and the natural one for a provider serving a logged-in business account.

blocks.en: The advantage of an attack is the paired difference of its hit rate to a stated baseline: the prior-only attacker A0 for single prompts, and the default attacker A1+ for the language-model attackers ( Section VIII-D ). Hit rates average over rows, so single-query rates weight product observations equally and linked-query rates weight firms equally. Every hit rate is achieved by a concrete attacker and is therefore a lower bound on what a provider with the same information can learn; an advantage compares two such attackers and is not a bound.

blocks.en: This section builds the tools that Q1–Q3 share: prompts whose true values are known, the attackers, the evaluation protocol, and checks of the implementation.

blocks.en: IV-A Counterfactual business prompts
blocks.zh: 反事实业务提示

blocks.en: We generate 300 counterfactual firms (50 for development, 250 for test) in six sectors: bakery/café, machine shop, apparel e-commerce, IT consulting, construction subcontractor and specialty retail. Each firm sells three to eight products. Prices follow a product-class median times a city price level, a firm brand premium and heavy-tailed noise; margins follow a sector median shifted by a latent firm efficiency, and each firm is drawn as extreme with probability 0.2. Sector margin medians are anchored to public aggregates: one minus the ratio of cost of goods sold to business receipts in the IRS Statistics of Income corporation tables for tax year 2022 [ 31 ] for five sectors, and the January 2026 Computer Services gross margin [ 32 ] for IT consulting, both modeling choices since an aggregate ratio is not a median firm’s margin. Generated sector medians are within 0.02 of these anchors, and 22.7% of firms fall outside their sector’s P10–P90 margin band. Prices, their dispersion within a class, volumes and overhead are documented assumptions ( Section S1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们在6个部门:面包店/咖啡馆、机器店、服装电子商务、信息技术咨询、建筑分包商和专用零售业产生300家反事实公司(50家用于开发,250家用于测试)。 每家公司销售三至八种产品。 价格采用产品级中值乘以城市价格水平、公司品牌溢价和大尾噪声;幅度采用部门中值,由潜在的公司效率转移,每个公司被抽取为极端,概率为0.2. 部门差值中值固定在公共总额上:一个减去收入公司统计表2022[31]中五个部门销售货物与商业收入的比例,另一个是2026年1月计算机服务总差值[32],用于信息技术咨询,两者都是模型选择,因为总比不是中位公司差值。 产生的部门中位数在0.02个以上,22.7%的公司不属于其部门的P10-P90比值范围。 价格、价格在一个类别内的分布、数量和间接费用是记录在案的假设(S1节)。

blocks.en: Each firm’s prompts name one of 60 US metropolitan areas sampled across the 2024 Regional Price Parities [ 33 ] and a positioning (premium, standard or discount). These cues are informative but weak: the correlation between the log price parity and a firm’s log price residual is 0.26. The attacker’s prior table is computed from a separate sample of 2,000 firms drawn from the same generator, an independent draw rather than a different population.
blocks.zh: 每个公司的提示点名2024年地区物价平价[33]和定位(优惠、标准或折扣)抽样的60个美国都会区之一。 这些提示信息丰富,但很薄弱:对价平价与一家公司的对价剩余值之间的关联性为0.26。 攻击者前一表是从从同一发电机抽取的2 000家公司的单独样本中抽取的,是独立抽取的,而不是不同的人群。

blocks.en: Five task templates (quote pricing, margin review, break-even, monthly sales summary, supplier comparison) turn a firm into a prompt; every firm contributes two tasks. The test split has 500 prompts with 700 product observations (450 distinct products); with three defense seeds this gives 2,100 rows per attacker and mechanism. Every number in a prompt is a typed field, and a test checks that no number appears in the prose outside a field. Only the numbers change under a disguise; the prose, including the city and positioning cues, stays identical. In the margin-review prompt of the first test firm, for example, a jacket priced 104.03 with unit cost 90.01 is shown as 195.47 and 169.13 under D1 (same margin) and as 298 and 81 under D3o at ε = 1 \varepsilon=1 (all four in Section S1 ).
blocks.zh: 5个任务模板(报价、差价审查、收支平衡、每月销售摘要、供应商比较)将一家公司变为一个即时;每个公司都贡献两个任务。 试验分解有500个提示,700个产品观察(450个不同产品);有3个防御种子,这给每个攻击者和机制2 100行。 提示中的每个数字都是一个打字字字段,以及一个字段外的散文中没有数字的测试检查. 只有数字在伪装下变化;包括城市和定位提示在内的道词保持不变. 例如,在第一试验公司的差值审查提示中,标有单位成本90.01的104.03号夹克显示为D1下195.47和169.13(相同差值),在D3o下标有298和81,在X=1\varepsilon=1(S1节中均为四)。

blocks.en: IV-B Attackers
blocks.zh: 四-B 攻击者

blocks.en: The default attacker A1+ is used for every mechanism; the language-model attackers are described in Section VIII-D .
blocks.zh: 默认攻击者A1+用于每个机制;语言模型攻击者在第八-D节中描述.

blocks.en: Predicts the class median margin and unit cost from the prior table, given the true sector and class.
blocks.zh: 根据真实的部门和类别,从上表中预测班次中值差值和单位成本。

blocks.en: The default attacker knows the mechanism and is told the true sector and product class, as is A0. Its prior draws log price and logit margin independently from Student- t t distributions with 3 degrees of freedom, centred at the class medians of the prior table, with scales that match the table’s interquartile ranges, multiplied by 0.75; shape and width were chosen on the development split from six candidates and then frozen for every mechanism and attacker. It reports the posterior median of each product’s margin and unit cost, which minimizes absolute error rather than maximizing the hit rate; Section V also evaluates hit-optimal decisions. The likelihood depends on the mechanism: • D1: the margin follows from the scale invariant, and the key from a grid posterior that combines the log-uniform key prior with each product’s price prior. • D1 ′ , D3o, D3: importance sampling with 4,000 prior draws, weighted by the exact likelihood of the shown values for D1 ′ (accounting for whole-cent rounding) and D3o, and by the truncated-Laplace density at the shown value for D3. • D2: each (price, cost) pair is scored jointly with a bivariate Gaussian approximation of ( log ⁡ h ⁡ ( p ) , log ⁡ h ⁡ ( c ) ) (\log h(p),\log h(c)) , whose moments are simulated over 16,000 secret maps.

blocks.zh: D1: 差值来自比值不变量, 键来自一个网格后键, 它在每种产品价格之前结合了对数-单数键。

blocks.en: D1 ′ , D3o, D3: importance sampling with 4,000 prior draws, weighted by the exact likelihood of the shown values for D1 ′ (accounting for whole-cent rounding) and D3o, and by the truncated-Laplace density at the shown value for D3.

blocks.en: D2: each (price, cost) pair is scored jointly with a bivariate Gaussian approximation of ( log ⁡ h ⁡ ( p ) , log ⁡ h ⁡ ( c ) ) (\log h(p),\log h(c)) , whose moments are simulated over 16,000 secret maps.
blocks.zh: D2: 每一对(价格,成本)与双变量高斯近似值(log ⁡ h ⁡ (p),log ⁡ h ⁡ (c)) (\log h(p),\log h(c))联合得分,其时刻模拟超过1.6万个密图.

blocks.en: The multi-query attacker extends A1+ to a firm’s sequence of prompts and targets product 0, which every template shows. Under D1 it uses the key ratios between queries and the public key range; under the other mechanisms it sums product 0’s log-likelihood over queries, counting deterministic repeats under a reused secret once. With one query it reproduces A1+ exactly.
blocks.zh: 多油攻击器将A1+扩展至一个公司的提示和目标产品0的序列,每个模板都显示. 在D1下,它使用查询和公共密钥范围之间的密钥比率;在其他机制下,它将产品0的对数比查询数加在一起,在一次重复使用的秘密下计算确定性重复。 它通过一个查询 复制A1+准确。

blocks.en: D2 is attacked by four attackers that differ in which shown values they model and how they approximate the likelihood, all with the same prior, oracle and decision rule; the three stronger ones serve Sections VII and VIII . The default A1+, the pair-only attacker , scores product 0’s (price, cost) pair with the Gaussian approximation above. A reference likelihood replaces that approximation with a kernel density over 20,000 simulated maps (bandwidth 0.03 in log units). A joint shared-map attacker models the prices and costs of all products shown under one map, and integrates the other products’ unchanged values over their class priors. A-exact is a particle approximation to the posterior under the exact display model: it samples maps from the public law, inverts every shown value and integrates the display rounding, and is used for single queries and reused maps ( Section IV-E ).
blocks.zh: D2受到四个攻击者的攻击,这四个攻击者显示了他们模拟的价值观,以及他们如何估计可能性,所有攻击者都具有相同的先前、甲骨文和决定规则;三个较强的攻击者服务于第七和第八节。 默认的 A1+, 单对攻击者, 参考概率用内核密度超过20,000张模拟地图(bandwidth 0.03 in log units)来取代该近似值. 一个共享地图攻击者联合模型,显示一个地图下显示的所有产品的价格和成本,并综合其他产品相对于其类前身的不变价值。 A-精确是精确显示模型下对后方的粒子近似:它从公法中取样地图,倒置每个显示值并整合显示四舍五入,用于单一查询和再利用地图(第四节-E节).

blocks.en: IV-C Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 四-C 评价协议

blocks.en: Attacker choices were made on the development split. The classical attackers were evaluated on the test split several times during development, including after the generator’s margins were replaced by the cited anchors. To guard against adaptive overfitting, we confirm the linked-query results on the first 60 test firms of a fresh draw of 300 firms (new generator seed, same prior table, frozen attacker; Section VIII-A ). The language-model attackers were evaluated on the test split once, with endpoints and a success criterion fixed beforehand; a third prespecified endpoint (C1c), defined under Zhang et al.’s topic shift, was not run because D2 omits the topic shift.
blocks.zh: 攻击者选择了开发分裂。 古典攻击者在开发期间,包括在发电机的边距被所引用的主播取代之后,在测试中被评估了几次。 为了防止适应性过强,我们确认300家公司新抽出的首批60家试验公司(新发电机种子,前台相同,冷冻攻击机;第八-A节)的结冰结果。 语言模型攻击者在测试分裂中被评估过一次,最终点数和成功标准事先固定;在张等人的专题转移下定义的第三个预先指定的终点(C1c)由于D2省略了专题转移而未运行.

blocks.en: All intervals over firms are paired percentile bootstrap 95% confidence intervals (CIs) that resample firms with all their rows (products and defense seeds), with 10,000 resamples (2,000 for the oracle-cue control of Section VIII-D ). The headline linked-query claim is checked with a Holm correction ( Section VI ); the other comparisons carry no multiplicity adjustment and are reported with their own intervals. Code, all result files (including the language-model outputs, which allow a replay without model calls), the prespecified plans and an evidence index are public at https://github.com/Jamli58/fresh-keys-stale-secrets .

Products drawn from the attacker’s own prior and disguised are recovered better than the prior median under D1 (+62.0 [59.9, 64.1] pp margin hit) and D3, but only by +0.8 [ − - 0.4, 1.9] pp under D1 ′ and +1.2 [ − - 1.3, 3.6] pp under D2, so a small single-prompt advantage under these two is expected even when the prior is correct.

blocks.en: We first ask what a per-prompt evaluation concludes, the starting point of Q1. Apart from shared scaling, the disguises appear to protect margins: in one prompt the default attacker recovers them at about the prior-only rate. Table IV and Fig. 3 give the results. Without a disguise the default attacker A1+ reads every value; the prior-only attacker A0, which knows the sector and class but ignores the numbers, hits 28.1% of margins and 16.0% of unit costs.
blocks.zh: 我们首先问,每一次评估得出什么结论,即问题1的起点。 除了共享的缩放外,伪装似乎还保护了边际:在一个瞬间,默认攻击者以大约只有先前的速度将其恢复. 表四和图3列出结果。 没有伪装,默认攻击者A1+读出每个值;先前唯一攻击者A0,它知道扇区和类但忽略数字,命中28.1%的边际和16.0%的单位成本.

blocks.en: Judged one prompt at a time, then, shared scaling exposes every margin, while under the other three mechanisms the default attacker’s margin advantage is at most 4.4 pp; under D2 the strongest attacker reaches +10.0 pp on prompts that show several products. Section VI asks whether this judgment holds when a firm queries the same numbers again.

blocks.en: We take the first 60 test firms in generation order (ten per sector) and let each ask 16 questions that cycle through the five templates. Every template shows product 0’s price and cost, so product 0 is the target. The templates differ in what else they show; margin review, for instance, adds the prices and costs of up to two more products ( Section S1 ). The threat model of Section III applies. Under the fresh regime every query draws a new secret (a new key, map or noise draw); under reuse one secret serves the whole sequence (D1, D1 ′ , D2). D3o, the money-noise branch of Pr ε ​ ε \varepsilon\varepsilon mpt, has no reusable secret: each release draws fresh noise. The multi-query A1+ of Section IV attacks the first n ∈ { 1 , 2 , 4 , 8 , 16 } n\in\{1,2,4,8,16\} queries of the same disguised sequence, so the curves are paired across n n . Each point pools 60 firms and three defense seeds (180 rows), so intervals span about ± 10 \pm 10 pp ( Section VIII-A repeats the comparison on all 250 test firms); the prior-only baseline for product 0 is 20.0% for margins and 15.0% for unit costs. Section VII compares the regimes on the same sequences.

blocks.en: A substitution that sorts the distinct values it maps and assigns them independently drawn sorted targets has this form, so any number of linked queries reveals the order and nothing more; this is the ideal notion of order-preserving encoding [ 35 ] . Our D2 instead ties each value’s target distribution to its position on a public signed-log axis, so each fresh map is an independent noisy reading of that position. Zhang et al. sort values into intervals and map them to random targets while preserving order [ 3 ] . Which case applies to their construction depends on whether the distribution of its transcript depends on the values beyond their rank pattern; fixing the intervals on a public axis, as our instantiation does, creates such dependence.

blocks.en: Random order-preserving functions are known to leak approximate values and distances, not only order [ 36 ] ; the map law sets how much. Varying the law, with the attacker told each law ( Table S6 ), the margin gain from n = 1 n=1 to 16 16 stays significant under every law we tried (+12.2 to +51.1 pp). It grows as the map becomes more regular, with more intervals or more even gaps. Under the most regular law (Dirichlet(10) gaps) even a single query gives a margin advantage of +28.0 [23.6, 32.5] pp, so how much one D2 prompt leaks is a property of the map law rather than of order preservation.

blocks.en: The answer to Q2 is that, for the disguises we study, freshness largely determines what the history discloses: a reused secret caps it at one view, whose invariants can still leak, while fresh secrets give repeated independent views that identify scaled values and locate values mapped on a public axis, unless every view depends on the values through an invariant alone.
blocks.zh: 对Q2的答案是,对于我们研究的伪装,新鲜度在很大程度上决定了历史所揭示的内容:一个重复使用的秘密封盖在一个视图中,它的不变量仍然可以泄露,而新的秘密则会反复给出独立的观点,这些观点可以识别在公共轴上绘制的缩放值和定位值,除非每个视图都通过一个不变量单独依赖于值.

blocks.en: Beyond the mechanism and a sector prior, a provider can exploit the prose. We test whether reading it with a language model adds substantially to what the numbers leak. blocks.en: First, evaluate a disguise against the history it produces, not one prompt ( Sections V and VI ). Second, choose between fresh and reused secrets deliberately: for field-local mechanisms, a reused secret for unchanged fields bounds history leakage ( Theorem 1 ) at the price of what the union view exposes, such as every margin under shared scaling. Third, test whether outputs depend on the values beyond an invariant such as their order: if not, fresh randomness discloses only that invariant, which may itself be sensitive ( Theorem 2 a, Proposition 4 ), whereas a public axis or an input-dependent domain adds such dependence.

blocks.en: XI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 十一 结论

blocks.en: Numeric prompt disguises are evaluated one prompt at a time, but a provider sees a firm’s history of queries. We have shown that this history matters: disguises that appear to protect margins in one prompt leak them as linked queries with fresh secrets accumulate (Pr ε ​ ε \varepsilon\varepsilon mpt at ε ≥ 0.5 \varepsilon\geq 0.5 ), whereas a reused secret caps the history at one full-precision view of the fields shown, whose invariants can still leak; under the order-preserving substitution, one joint attacker gains 29.4 pp more in margin hits with fresh maps than with one reused map. Disguises for repeatedly queried numbers should therefore be evaluated against the history they produce, with the choice between fresh and reused secrets made deliberately. Future work should test the results on disclosed product-line margins, evaluate the suggested mitigations, and measure Zhang et al.’s pipeline.
blocks.zh: 数字的即时伪装每次被一个即时评价,但提供商会看到公司的查询历史. 我们已表明,这一历史关系重大:一个瞬间泄露的伪装似乎保护了边缘,因为与新秘密有关的询问不断累积(Pr ε ε varepsilon\ varepsilon mpt at ≥ ≥ ≥ 0.5 \ varepsilon\geq 0.5),而一个再利用的秘密封顶历史,在一个完全精确的视野里,显示的字段,其变异物仍然可以泄露;在维护命令的替代下,一个联合攻击者在带新地图的比用新地图的差值增加29.4页。 因此,对于反复被问及的数字的欺骗行为,应当根据它们产生的历史加以评估,在新的和重复使用的秘密之间作出选择。 今后的工作应在披露的产品线差值上检验结果,评价所建议的减轻影响措施,并衡量张等人的管道。

blocks.en: On the development prompts the models’ city price levels correlate with the regional price parities (Spearman 0.63 for Llama and 0.53 for Qwen), and they assign lower prices to discount firms and higher prices to premium firms. In our generator, however, the city explains little of a product’s price relative to the spread within a product class: feeding the true city level into the same solver gives +2.3 [0.8, 4.0] pp on D3 ε = 0.5 \varepsilon=0.5 unit cost, and adding the true brand premium gives between − 1.0 -1.0 and +4.0 pp across endpoints, the largest with interval [ − - 1.5, 9.3] pp (D1 unit cost). A4 gained +1.9 [ − - 3.4, 7.0] pp (Llama) and − - 2.3 [ − - 7.9, 3.2] pp (Qwen) on C1a, and +2.4 [0.7, 4.3] pp (Llama) and +2.0 [ − - 0.1, 4.0] pp (Qwen) on the C1b unit-cost endpoint; margin differences on C1b were negative, and no difference is significant under D3o. Only one model had a gain with an interval above zero, so the prespecified two-model criterion was not met. Replacing the models’ sector and class answers by the truth while keeping their cue shifts (A4-TL) changes any difference by at most 0.43 pp; the largest observed gain is +2.5 [0.8, 4.3] pp (A4-TL, Llama, D3 ε = 0.5 \varepsilon=0.5 unit cost).
